title: psychotria longirostris
intro: Psychotria longirostris, commonly known as the Long-beaked Wild Coffee or simply Wild Coffee, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. The health benefits of Psychotria longirostris include its potential to help lower blood pressure, manage diabetes, and provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protector, likely due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and polyphenols. The bioactive constituents present in Psychotria longirostris include xanthines, which contribute to its coffee-like effects.
